title: About
text:
About
I’m a fourth year economics undergraduate at Azim Premji University, Bengaluru. My interests lie across labour economics, industrial organization, and econometrics.
I’m currently working on modelling labour market transitions in India, as part of my undergraduate thesis under Prof. Rajendran Narayanan. I also work as a research assistant under Prof. Chinmaya Kumar.
PS: Love to chat; feel free to reach out!
